Python Master Sheet for Interviews

How to use this sheet

Built to cover the coding, Python, and DSA rounds at TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Deloitte, Cognizant, Capgemini and similar MNCs in one place — basics through advanced. Every topic opens with short notes (definition, type, and a worked example) for each individual concept, then interview questions, then coding problems.

Tap any question or problem to expand its answer. Tick items as you finish them; progress stays in this browser. The 🐍 Python terminal floats at the bottom-right of the screen at all times — click "Run" on any example to open it and try the code instantly, without losing your place on the page.

Say every answer out loud in 60 seconds, and state time and space complexity for every coding solution.

Service company tests

TCS NQT/Ninja, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Capgemini, HCL: aptitude, verbal, then 1 to 3 coding problems (strings, arrays, patterns, number programs), then technical and HR.

Digital, Prime and specialist tiers

TCS Digital/Prime, Infosys Specialist Programmer, Wipro Turbo, Accenture advanced tracks, Deloitte: medium DSA, OOP, SQL, a deep project round and cloud or DevOps scenarios. This is the tier that reaches 7 LPA or more.

Product and startup rounds

Medium to hard DSA, clean code, Python internals, concurrency, and light system design. Projects are questioned line by line.

Hiring patterns and packages change every year. Confirm the current pattern on each company's careers page.
